decisions.rationale: NOA total income of $101,533 and pay stub run-rate of about $105k are roughly 20% below the stated $131,500, a material shortfall requiring escalation.
The $35,834 balance covers the $34,000 down payment but leaves only about $1.8k, which is unlikely to cover closing costs.
Panel appraiser value of $343,000 supports the price, but the appraiser recommends an engineer foundation inspection and it is unclear whether this must be cleared.
Ratios of about 34% GDS and 41% TDS (with the omitted $367 home equity line) rely on the stated income, which is not supported; on documented income they would exceed 39%/44%.
